# book_bookable (Resource)

The bookable records of the service, through its state import and export



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) the record key, its identity in the service and in references
- `name` (String) Display name of the bookable.
- `owner_id` (String) Organisation that owns the bookable.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Free form notes about the bookable.
- `external_id` (String) Caller supplied identifier from an external system.
- `icon` (String) The library icon the bookable is shown with: a glyph name, text or a raw svg
- `is_bookable` (Boolean) When false the bookable exists in the access tree but does not accept bookings.
- `location_id` (String) Location the bookable belongs to.
- `parent_id` (String) Parent bookable when nesting under another resource.
- `type_id` (String) Bookable type the resource inherits behaviour from.
- `user_id` (String) User the bookable represents; null clears the link
